about: The days of the year she knows, per country (its ISO 3166 code, as the user's location and Nager.Date name it). A day is a fixed date (MM-DD) or a public holiday by its Nager.Date names (lunar days move every year). tone: festive (a greeting), solemn (remembered quietly, never a party), plain. off: a day off for her as an office worker there, whatever the public holidays say (Labor Day in Korea). about: what the day is, told after its name. Another country: add its list under its code.
